Hi Olinda,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to move to a short executive intro + product demo for the NovusEnergy team. To make the session useful for your CIO and VP of Engineering, we'd like to propose a 30–40 minute slot that covers:
- 10m executive intro and high-level ROI/architecture fit
- 15–20m focused demo (latency/cost guardrails and private deployment options)
- 5–10m Q&A and next steps / mutual action items

Can you confirm whether the CIO would prefer a concise 30m walkthrough or a 45m slot for deeper technical questions? Below are windows that work on our side next week:
- Tue 9/14: 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 9/15: 13:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 9/16: 08:30–11:00 PT

If you prefer, here's a booking link with the same availability: https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-demo-30

Attaching the latest mutual action plan (Novus-MAP-v2.pdf) — it contains proposed success criteria and stakeholders.

If the CIO needs a short pre-brief with our CTO, we can schedule a 15-minute pre-call the day before.

Thanks,
Karthik

Hi everyone — confirmed for Wed 9/15, 13:15–13:45 PT. Proposed run-of-show for a tight 30m:
- 00:00–03:00 — Quick intros and expected outcomes (Karthik + Olinda)
- 03:00–12:00 — High-level demo: how Redwood delivers predictable latency and cost across hosted vs private deployments (Marissa)
- 12:00–25:00 — Architecture/ops Q&A: KV cache, autoscaling, and private deployment controls (Marissa + Grace)
- 25:00–30:00 — Next steps & mutual action items (Karthik)

I'll keep the deck to 4 slides and demo driven — primary ask for the CIO will be to validate whether our private deployment options meet Novus's data isolation requirements. I'll also have a short checklist for procurement re: SOC 2 artifacts and EULA pointers.

Attachment: demo-runbook.md (text/markdown) — includes links to the SOC 2 summary and our standard mutual NDA template.

If procurement needs a formal DocuSign, we can generate that once the NDA is agreed.
